subject: hearts
text: In a new area of the sewers, hearts can be collected before proceeding to the next room.

evidence.quote:
Follow the overworld path along and you will be in a new area of the sewers. 
Time to find Zoda! Get the hearts here, and in the next room, kill the 
enemies, trigger the switch third from the right, get the weapon, and move 
onto the next room.

subject: weapon
text: In the room following the entrance area of the sewers, defeat the enemies and trigger the switch third from the right to get the weapon.

evidence.quote:
and in the next room, kill the 
enemies, trigger the switch third from the right, get the weapon, and move 
onto the next room.

subject: giant rats
text: Giant rats move slow, so hit them a few times, move back, hit them again, and repeat until defeated.

evidence.quote:
The next room has giant rats. Just follow the strategy I 
gave you before. They move slow, so just hit them a few times, move back, hit 
them again, and repeat the process until they are defeated.

subject: middle left tile switch
text: Kill all enemies in the room, hit the switch in the middle left tile, then return to the previous room and hit the switch to open the door.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the enemies in the next room, then hit the switch in the middle left 
tile. Go back to the previous room and hit the switch. Go through the door 
that opened, and follow the rafts and platforms along.

subject: item
text: Jump on the moving raft down to get an item, then return to the start of the room.

evidence.quote:
First, jump on the 
moving raft down to get an item, then go back to the beginning of the room and 
jump on the moving raft to the right.

subject: moving rafts
text: Jump on the moving raft to the right, stop on the platform, wait for the next moving raft, and jump from moving raft to moving raft to exit the room.

evidence.quote:
jump on the moving raft to the right. Stop on the platform here, and wait for 
the next moving raft. Jump on it, and just jump on moving raft to moving raft 
to get out of this room.

subject: medicine
text: In the room past the jumping blue slimes, the middle set of tiles has a switch on the left to get a medicine, and stepping on the right tile opens a doorway containing a medicine.

evidence.quote:
The middle 
set of tiles has a switch on the left. Get a medicine this way, then step on 
the right tile to open a doorway containing a medicine.

subject: stairs and tiles
text: Go up the stairs, fall down the middle set of tiles, go down, defeat the giant rats, and proceed through the door that opened to defeat the green enemies.

evidence.quote:
Go up the stairs, then 
fall down the middle set of tiles. Go down, and kill the giant rats again. Go 
through the door that opened, kill the green enemies, and move on to the next 
room.

subject: disc
text: Grab the hearts, jump from raft to raft onto the tiles, hit the switch in the upper middle tile, and grab the disc.

evidence.quote:
grab the hearts, then jump from raft 
to raft, onto the tiles. Hit the switch in the upper middle tile. Grab the 
disc and then jump onto the platform when you see the raft near you.

subject: disappearing platform
text: The platform disappears when stepped on, so jump onto it only when a clean jump can be made to a nearby raft.

evidence.quote:
The 
platform disappears when you step on it, so only jump when you can make a 
clean jump.

subject: medicine
text: In the next room, defeat the enemies and grab the medicine.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, kill the enemies and grab the medicine, then go 
back to the previous room, kill the enemies again, and hit the switch in the 
bottom right hand corner.

subject: bottom right hand corner switch
text: Return to the previous room, defeat the enemies again, and hit the switch in the bottom right hand corner to access the boss room.

evidence.quote:
then go 
back to the previous room, kill the enemies again, and hit the switch in the 
bottom right hand corner. The next room has the toughest boss yet by far.

subject: Zoda
text: Zoda shoots four blue flames from the floor when far away, shoots five skulls at short range which can be jumped over, and teleports around the room a few seconds after attacking.

evidence.quote:
He has two 
attacks. One is an attack where he shoots four blue flames out from the floor. 
He does this when you are far away from him. He also has a short range attack 
where he shoots five skulls out, but you can jump over them. He also teleports 
around the room a few seconds after he does an attack.

subject: Zoda
text: The floor tiles have arrows that push the player around, so jump constantly, jump near Zoda when he appears, jump over his skeletons, and hit him before he teleports.

evidence.quote:
The main tricky part here is the flooring, which have little arrows on every 
tile, so you will constantly be moving around in whatever direction they see 
fit. That's why I jumped around a LOT during this battle. As soon as Zoda 
appeared, I jumped near him, jumped over his skeletons, and hit him a few 
times before he teleported.

subject: Tetrad
text: Defeating Zoda rewards a tetrad.

evidence.quote: You'll get a tetrad! Walk outside and talk to Sherlock Holmes.

subject: dynamite
text: Bob's Store in the lower right hand corner gives dynamite, which can be used to find gold nuggets and a cave entrance.

evidence.quote:
Go into Bob's Store in the lower 
right hand corner, and he will agree to give you some dynamite, which you can 
use to find gold nuggets and maybe the entrance to a cave with a tetrad in it.

subject: Big Heart
text: Go all the way west, then down, and place dynamite between the two rocks to reveal a Big Heart.

evidence.quote:
First, let's get a big heart. Go all the way west, then down, and place the 
dynamite between the two rocks. In here is a Big Heart!

subject: Gold Cave entrance
text: On the west side of the mountain, place dynamite three spots lower than the southern golden colored passageway to unlock the passage to the Gold Cave.

evidence.quote:
go to the west side of the mountain. You'll see two golden 
colored rock passageways to the south of here. Place the dynamite three spots 
lower than the southern golden colored passageway to unlock the passage to the 
Gold Cave.

subject: rolling boulders
text: In the room with three skinny platforms, boulders roll across that cause instant death, so jump up or down to the next platform when a boulder comes near.

evidence.quote:
This 
room has three skinny platforms with boulders that roll across. The boulders 
are instant death, so be careful. When you see a boulder come near you, jump 
up or down to the next platform.

subject: middle platform pit
text: After defeating the snakes, jump in the platform in the middle to fall through to another room.

evidence.quote:
The next room has my mortal enemy, snakes, so take care of them and jump in 
the platform in the middle. You'll fall through to another room.

subject: jumping chests
text: Jumping chests turn into super fast moving coins when hurt, so attack them as quickly as possible.

evidence.quote:
Here, you'll see jumping 
chests, and when you hurt one, they'll turn into SUPER fast moving coins. The 
best bet is to just attack them as quickly as you can.

subject: bola
text: Grab the bola in the chest.

evidence.quote:
Grab the bola in the 
chest, then kill the enemies in the next room to get a Medicine from the 
chest.

subject: Medicine
text: Defeat the enemies in the room after the bola to get a Medicine from the chest.

evidence.quote:
kill the enemies in the next room to get a Medicine from the 
chest. Go back to the previous room and head left for the first boss in here.

subject: Miner
text: Touching the Miner causes instant death; attack him normally when he holds a boulder up, jump and shoot when he holds it down, and jump over thrown boulders.

evidence.quote:
He will get a 
boulder from the wall, and throw it at you occasionally, then inch slowly to 
the right. You obviously have to kill him before he gets too close to you, 
since touching him means instant death. Just hit him normally when he holds 
the rock up, and when he has it down, jump and shoot. Jump over the boulder 
and you can get in a few more sneaky hits as well, if you wish.

subject: Super Psychic Shockwave
text: In the room past the Miner, talk to the donkey to receive the Super Psychic Shockwave upgrade to your psychic weapon.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, talk to the donkey and you'll get the upgrade to your 
psychic weapon. Yay.

Go to the 
next room, and use the Super Psychic Shockwave weapon that you just 
received to hit some scorpions.

subject: hearts
text: In the second part of the Gold Cave, hit the tile switch in the bottom right hand corner to get hearts.

evidence.quote:
Go to the second part of this cave, and hit the tile 
switch in the bottom right hand corner to get some much needed hearts.

subject: medicine
text: After being shot onto the fast moving belt, jump to the right upon entering the next room to collect a medicine.

evidence.quote:
Go in the next room, and you'll be shot onto a 
fast moving belt. As soon as you're in the next room, jump to the right to get 
a medicine, then jump back on and jump off at the third room.

subject: medicine bottle
text: Defeat the scorpions to open a wall, jump up and defeat the two enemies, enter the opened wall to grab hearts, and hit the switch next to it to get a medicine bottle.

evidence.quote:
Kill the scorpions, and you'll see a wall open up on the other side. Jump up 
(not onto the belt), and kill the two enemies. Go around and into the wall you 
just opened. Grab the hearts and then hit the switch next to it, and get the 
medicine bottle.

subject: medicine
text: In the room following the chest enemies, hit the crack in the wall to get more medicine.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, hit the crack in the wall to 
get more medicine. The next room has more boulders, so follow the strategy I 
gave you before.

subject: invincibility star
text: Hit the switch and get the invincibility star, then kill all the enemies to head through the door.

evidence.quote:
Hit the switch and get the invincibility star, then kill all the enemies to 
head through the door.

subject: mine cart enemy
text: A guy on a mine cart drives by throwing fire and shooting bullets; follow his pattern and land hits when possible.

evidence.quote:
This next room has a boss-like enemy, but he's not. 
He's a guy on a mine cart that drives by throwing fire and shooting bullets. 
Follow his pattern and get in some hits when you can.

subject: medicine
text: After defeating the mine cart enemy, scorpions, and ghosts, hit the switch and kill the snakes to open a secret room, then hit the crack in the wall to get the medicine.

evidence.quote:
When you defeat him, 
kill the scorpions and ghosts, hit the switch, and kill the snakes to open 
another secret room. In this room, hit the crack in the wall to get the 
medicine.

subject: star
text: Hit the switch in the secret room to grab another star.

evidence.quote:
Hit the switch and grab another star. Head out, and you'll be up to 
the boss!

subject: Miner Skeleton
text: When the Miner Skeleton slams his hammer into the ground, jump immediately to avoid freezing as boulders fall from the sky and emerge from his hammer.

evidence.quote:
When the battle starts, he will slam his 
hammer into the ground. Mike will freeze for a second, boulders will come from 
the sky, and boulders will come out of his hammer. Yep. The way to prevent 
this freezing from occurring is by jumping when he throws the hammer down, so 
jump right away.

subject: Miner Skeleton
text: Use the invincibility star and shockwave weapon against the Miner Skeleton to land multiple hits without taking damage.

evidence.quote:
I hope you saved those medicines and the star, because you can use 
it now to get in a bunch of hits with the shockwave weapon without taking any 
damage.

subject: Tetrad
text: Defeating the Miner Skeleton awards a tetrad, completing Chapter 5.

evidence.quote:
You get a tetrad, and this chapter is over! Only a few more chapters left to 
go!

subject: plaster man building
text: In Italy, enter the building where a guy is trapped in plaster with Zoda's tracks, then go down the stairs to reach the Basement.

evidence.quote:
Walk 
around here and enter the place, and you'll see a disturbing sight. A guy has 
been trapped in plaster and there are Zoda's tracks here! Go down the stairs 
now.

subject: flying balls and dropping machines
text: Avoid the flying balls that move in circles, and watch the pattern of machines dropping balls to run underneath them when the balls go up.

evidence.quote:
There's no enemies, but there's some flying balls here that move in a circle 
that you need to avoid. Then, watch the pattern of the machines that drop 
balls, and wait for the balls to go up before running underneath them.

subject: mid-air spikes
text: Jump straight forward between moving platforms to avoid mid-air spikes, as moving in mid-air causes instant death.

evidence.quote:
The 
following section has spikes in mid air, so carefully jump from moving 
platform to moving platform while avoiding these annoyances. Just jump 
straight forward for your best hope, if you move in mid air you'll definitely 
run into the spikes and it'll be death for you!

subject: balls and holes puzzle
text: Balls travel in the direction they are hit, and all balls must be knocked into holes across two rooms to complete the area.

evidence.quote:
The next two rooms have balls and holes. The balls go 
in the direction that you hit them. You need to get all the balls into the 
holes in order to complete this area.

subject: hammer and chisel
text: Get the hammer and chisel in the Art Studio to warp back to Leonardo DaVinci trapped in plaster.

evidence.quote:
Now you're in the ST-ST-STUDIO! Get the hammer and chisel here, and you'll be 
warped back to where you found that dude trapped in plaster before at the 
beginning of the basement.

subject: Katana
text: Leonardo DaVinci gives the player the Katana weapon.

evidence.quote:
Leonardo DaVinci, who is grateful 
and explains that he was asked by a strange man about an old stone he saw in a 
castle to the east.

He will hook you up with the Katana weapon for your troubles

subject: flying machine
text: Leonardo DaVinci gives a flying machine that allows travel to the castle to the east.

evidence.quote:
and then he'll 
also give you a flying machine, which will enable you to get to that castle to 
get the tetrad.

subject: Big Heart
text: Get the Big Heart to the west before proceeding to the castle.

evidence.quote: Get the Big Heart to the west before proceeding to the castle.

subject: Castle maze sequence
text: Walk up into the hallway and fall into a hole, defeat all enemies and leave; back in the maze go down the stairs, left, fall into another hole before stairs, clear the area and go down the stairs, go two left, one down, all the way left, up the stairs, clear another hole at the intersection, then from the footprints go one down, two right, one up, two right, one down, and all the way right.

evidence.quote:
Walk up into the 
hallway, and soon you will fall into a hole. Kill all the enemies and then 
leave here. Back in the maze, go down the stairs, then go left, and then fall 
into another hole before the stairs. Just do the same thing as before, then 
once back on land, go down the stairs. Go two left, one down, and all the way 
left, up the stairs. At the intersection, you'll go into another hole. 
Complete this mini area, then get to the footprints and go one down, two 
right, one up, two right, one down, and then all the way right.

subject: Tetrad
text: Navigating to the end of the Castle maze awards a tetrad and increases the life meter.

evidence.quote:
You'll get a tetrad and your life meter will be increased! Zoda-Y will not be 
pleased about this development, and you'll soon be sent off to yet another 
time period..

subject: hearts
text: There is a pair of hearts at the entrance of Dracula's Castle.

evidence.quote:
There's a pair of hearts here if you need them. Go right and go all the way 
right and take that doorway to the next room.

subject: medicine
text: Go right through the doorway, defeat the bats, and collect the medicine in the next room.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the bats, then get the 
medicine in the next room.

subject: medicine
text: Defeat the ghosts as they appear to open up a room containing a medicine surrounded by randomly rising fire.

evidence.quote:
In this room, kill the ghosts as they appear to open up a room, which contains 
a medicine. Fire randomly comes up around it, so be wary of that as you go to 
get the item.

subject: tombstone enemy
text: Defeat the enemy by attacking its tombstone, then proceed into the next room.

evidence.quote:
Kill the enemy here by attacking its tombstone, and then 
proceed into the next room.

subject: chest trap and luck sign
text: Jumping toward the chest drops the player into a hole; go diagonally left or right to find a Try Your Luck sign.

evidence.quote:
Jump to the chest, and fall in the hole. Go diagonally left or right and try 
your luck with the sign

subject: hearts
text: Go right, follow the path, defeat the enemies to get hearts, and hit the switch to the right.

evidence.quote:
Go 
right, and then follow the path. Kill the enemies and get the hearts, then hit 
the switch to the right.

subject: medicine
text: In the room with sleepwalking enemies, kill them to open a room containing a medicine, then return and hit the top right corner switch to proceed.

evidence.quote:
Keep going until you get to a room with sleepwalking 
enemies. Kill the enemies to open up a room with a medicine, then go back and 
hit the switch in the top right hand corner to proceed.
